name: entomatical
description: Manage Claude Code, Codex, Grok and Antigravity tasks in Git worktrees, with checks, orchestration and optional dictation.

commands.title: Entomatical: Open Tasks in Claude Code Panel
Entomatical: Parakeet: Show Installed CLI Help
Entomatical: Open Board in Editor Tab

entomatical.notifications.description: Show a notification when a task started from the board needs input or finishes.

entomatical.quietStartup.description: On startup or reload, show the Entomatical board and the session tabs that were open, nothing else: close the right (secondary) sidebar and turn off chatgpt.openOnStartup, so Codex does not open and load its sidebar there.

enumDescriptions: Ask and Auto open a terminal for approvals. Bypass opens in Codex's editor before the first turn with the permission-aware panel bridge, or after the background turn otherwise. Needs the Codex extension (openai.chatgpt).
The Codex CLI runs in a terminal in the task's worktree, with follow-ups, Stop and Resume from the board.

entomatical.codexPath.description: The Codex CLI that runs Codex tasks, sign-in and usage reads. Empty: in WSL when chatgpt.runCodexInWindowsSubsystemForLinux is on (the `codex` on the Ubuntu distro's PATH), else chatgpt.cliExecutable, else the `codex` installed on PATH (for example `npm i -g @openai/codex`). Never the Codex extension's bundled copy. Takes effect after a window reload.

entomatical.autoStart.description: Start a task's Claude session as soon as it is added.

entomatical.maxRunning.description: How many cards may be in Running before a new auto-started or Start after card waits in Queued for a slot. 0: no limit. Start on a card always goes ahead.

entomatical.workflow.localBudget.description: How many local preparation steps of an imported plan may run at once. Payload work on external worker stays one job regardless.

entomatical.contextSource.description: The context source shown for new cards. Existing card links remain active when it changes.

entomatical.obsidian.folder.description: The local Obsidian vault or folder whose Markdown notes cards can link to. Set it with Entomatical: Choose Obsidian Folder.

entomatical.asana.project.description: The Asana project (its id or link) whose tasks cards can be linked to. Set it with Entomatical: Choose Asana Project. The token comes from ASANA_PAT, else Entomatical: Set Asana Token.

enumDescriptions: Local whisper.cpp. Requires a whisper-cli executable and model file. Audio stays on this machine.
Local Parakeet via parakeet-cli. Transcribes after Stop or silence; audio stays on this machine.
OpenAI Transcriptions API. Requires your API key; audio is uploaded to OpenAI.
Groq Whisper API. Requires your API key; audio is uploaded to Groq.
Deepgram Nova API. Requires your API key; audio is uploaded to Deepgram.
entomatical.speech.provider.description: Speech recognition provider. Independent local and cloud options do not use Claude or Codex login tokens.

entomatical.speech.whisperPath.description: Optional advanced executable override. Usually discovered from the Whisper folder.

entomatical.speech.modelPath.description: Selected local model. Choose from the model dropdown on the board.

entomatical.speech.silenceSeconds.description: Local Whisper or Parakeet dictation stops by itself after this many seconds of silence, in tenths of a second (for example 1.2 or 4.5). Text still in progress is put in the text box.

entomatical.speech.language.description: Language code, or auto for automatic detection (Deepgram uses detect_language). Parakeet detects language automatically and ignores this setting.

entomatical.speech.model.description: Optional cloud model override. Blank uses gpt-transcribe (OpenAI), whisper-large-v3-turbo (Groq), or nova-3 (Deepgram).

entomatical.speech.whisperFolder.description: Local Whisper installation folder. Select it from the board to discover executables and model files.

entomatical.speech.parakeetFolder.description: Parakeet installation folder. If empty, looks in the Whisper folder for parakeet-cli and compatible Parakeet models.

entomatical.speech.parakeetPath.description: Optional advanced parakeet-cli executable override. Never uses whisper-cli.

entomatical.speech.parakeetModelPath.description: Selected Parakeet TDT GGML model. Separate from the Whisper model selection.

entomatical.speech.parakeetThreads.description: CPU threads passed to parakeet-cli. Minimum 1. Applies to dictation and file transcription.

entomatical.speech.parakeetUseGpu.description: Use GPU acceleration. Turn off to pass --no-gpu and run on CPU.

entomatical.speech.parakeetGpuDevice.description: Zero-based GPU device index passed to --device. The installed CLI help lists detected devices. Ignored for computation when Use GPU is off.

entomatical.speech.parakeetPrintSegments.description: Include segments and token timing/probability fields in Last Transcription Details. Details contain recognized speech and remain in memory until replaced or the window closes.

entomatical.speech.parakeetQuiet.description: Suppress most Parakeet model and timing diagnostics (--no-prints). Startup backend and audio-decoder messages may still appear. Does not suppress requested segment details.

entomatical.deliver.everyTurns.description: Bring a card's work into the main folder at the end of every N turns, and when the card reaches Review. 0: only Finish does.

name.description: What the vault is called in Finish's dialog and on the card. Default: the helper's file name.

command.description: The full path of the installed helper. It is run as it is, with no shell. A file inside the repo is refused.

args.description: The helper's arguments for an upload, exactly as given here.

verifyArgs.description: Optional: arguments with which the helper exits 0 only when the vault already holds the repo as it is now. Used before another upload when the branch moved or the last upload did not report a result. Without it you are asked instead.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long the helper may run, PIN and touch included, before its terminal is closed and the upload is left pending.

entomatical.finish.vaults.markdownDescription:
Finish to an encrypted vault, for a repo with no Git remote to push to. An object from a repo's main folder (full path) to its upload helper, for example `{ "/home/user/sample-project": { "name": "recovery vault", "command": "/home/user/.local/bin/sample-vault", "args": ["push"] } }`.

Finish of a repo listed here merges into the local branch only, whatever the branch tracks: no Git remote is fetched or pushed. After the merge, your own Finish (its dialog shows the vault and the command) runs the helper in a terminal, where it asks for your PIN and a touch itself. The helper gets the window's own environment; `terminal.integrated.env.*` is not applied to it. If it does not finish, the merge stays and the card says the upload is pending; **Entomatical: Upload to Vault** tries it again. An automatic finish and `board.js finish <id>` merge and stop at upload pending.

Read from your user settings only: a workspace's or folder's settings cannot set it. A repo not listed here finishes as before.

entomatical.orchestrator.enabled.description: Enable card delegation and saved plan runs. Turning this off hides Allow delegation and disables agent requests through the board inbox.

entomatical.orchestrator.caps.description: Caps the board enforces on every run (docs/agents/README.md): open (unfinished, uncancelled cards at once), total (default 600; root-wide cards over the run; adjustable at plan approval), depth (default 4, maximum 8), followUps (per child), pointsFiveHour (refuse opening a card on an account past this many points of its 5-hour window; unset = no limit), points (the run's measured budget: points of the 5-hour window its cards' runs moved, across accounts; at 80 % the master is told, at 100 % the run is paused, each once; unset = no budget). pending (notices before a watcher), watchers (maximum coordinators) and perWatcher (cards per watcher) apply only when automatic watchers are explicitly enabled during run approval.

entomatical.orchestrator.childNotificati.description: Show the usual 'needs your input' and 'finished' notifications for cards an orchestrator opened. Off: the run raises one notification per event that matters (started, a card needs you, paused, finished).

entomatical.orchestrator.claimAfterMinut.description: board.js claim (F95): how long a card's holder must sit in Review, Queued or Needs input with no live session before an orchestrator may take its cards without asking. A holder that is Done or cancelled needs no wait, nor one from an earlier run of the same plan file.

entomatical.battleRoyale.enabled.markdownDescription:
Show the **Battle Royale** button on the new-task form. Off (the default) hides it and refuses every battle.

Battle Royale gives one prompt to several models at once: each contestant gets its own card, running in its card terminal with every permission (Bypass) and nobody to answer its questions or approve its plan. You then compare the results and keep the best one. The board's Haiku title, Done when, parent and Allow delegation setting apply to every contestant; the form's account, model, effort and permission do not. Contestants are set in `#entomatical.battleRoyale.contestants#`. By default the arena is cleared first (see `#entomatical.battleRoyale.clearArena#`). It costs as much as every contestant together.

provider.description: Which CLI this contestant runs on.

model.description: Model short name or id, for example fable, opus, sol or carbon. Empty: the provider's default (Sol for Codex). Ignored for Grok.

effort.description: Effort, for example max, high or ultra. Empty: the provider's default (for Codex, the model's top effort). Ignored for Grok.

account.description: Account name as the board's account list shows it. Empty: the form's account when it is this provider's, else this provider's first signed-in account.

entomatical.battleRoyale.contestants.markdownDescription: Battle Royale's contestants, one card each, in this order: how many fight (2 to 8) and on which provider, model, effort and account. A provider may appear more than once (its cards are then titled Claude 1, Claude 2 and so on). A contestant whose account is not signed in is skipped with a warning; fewer than two left refuses the battle.

entomatical.battleRoyale.clearArena.markdownDescription: Before a battle, clear the arena: every running card and run on this window's boards is warned, given 30 seconds to save its work, then stopped and parked in Review, and leftover agent processes are ended. Off: nothing is stopped, and the contestants run beside the cards already running.
